scope.object: the null laws of docs/THE_BAR.md: its fixed-rule p = r, its scan formula, its correction over looks and its grade names
hypotheses: C1, the census's own law: within a stratum the carriers are placed uniformly at random, independently of the fixed rule
C3, the i.i.d. law: the comparable units and the chosen one i.i.d. Bernoulli(q); checked for n <= 2000 and five levels
C2 is checked for every k <= n <= 2000 (exact rationals to n = 120); no general theorem is claimed beyond that range
nothing about any frame, state or census outcome is computed; no grade on the record is recomputed from data

hits.bearing: the request this arc answers: binomial coverage against exact finite-census fractions, the selector's null law for p = r, a dependence law for Sidak, and rarity kept apart from derivation and admission
the bar as sealed and banked; null_model.sidak's docstring names independent looks; its grades and two sealed decisions are re-read, none changes
main adopted the bar unamended, DERIVED included; the amendment is relayed for adoption
where the Sidak step and the 0.01 gate come from; neither states a dependence law; B614's own campaign is not re-judged
DERIVED there means the theory outputs it and the framework does not fix it; the bar's top grade is renamed PASSED, necessary but not sufficient for it
absent: the record had no finite-population law for the bar and no dependence condition for its Sidak step

queries: Sidak 1967 rectangular confidence regions means multivariate normal distributions inequality
Berger Boos 1994 P values maximized over a confidence set for the nuisance parameter JASA
Phipson Smyth 2010 permutation p-values should never be zero (b+1)/(m+1) exact

sources.cite: Z. Sidak, Rectangular confidence regions for the means of multivariate normal distributions, JASA 62 (1967) 626-633
sources.says: for a normal vector with zero means and any correlations, P(|X_1| <= c_1, ..., |X_k| <= c_k) >= the product of the marginals: two-sided normal events only

sources.cite: B. Phipson and G. K. Smyth, Permutation P-values should never be zero, Stat. Appl. Genet. Mol. Biol. 9 (2010) Article 39 (arXiv:1603.05766)
sources.says: under the null the count B is discrete uniform on 0..m, so the exact p-value is (b + 1)/(m + 1)

sources.cite: A. Vexler, Valid p-values and expectations of p-values revisited (arXiv:2001.05126), stating R. L. Berger and D. D. Boos, JASA 89 (1994) 1012-1016
sources.says: with a nuisance parameter, the supremum of p over a 1 - beta confidence set plus beta is a valid p-value

sources.cite: R stats package, binom.test documentation (Clopper and Pearson, Biometrika 26 (1934) 404-413)
sources.says: an exact test for the probability of success in a Bernoulli experiment; the Clopper-Pearson interval guarantees a confidence level of at least conf.level

sources.where: Sidak: introduction and Usage; Bonferroni: Definition
sources.says: Sidak is exact for independent tests, conservative for positively and liberal for negatively dependent ones; Bonferroni needs no assumption about dependence

claim_one_line: THE BAR'S NULL CONTRACT (not sealed; the audit lane's request at 24c039c8): the bar's p now has a stated law. Under the census's own law (carriers placed exchangeably in a stratum, independently of the fixed rule) the exact p is (k+1)/(n+1), and the bar's r is at least that for every k <= n <= 2000, so p = r is conservative; under an i.i.d. law its gate has size <= alpha (0.0037 at 0.01, n <= 2000). A binomial interval certifies nothing beyond the census. The scan's binomial understates p and is replaced by the hypergeometric law; Sidak over looks fails at the gate (two picks in one stratum of 399 with 2 carriers: size 0.0100125) and is replaced by Bonferroni or the exact joint law. The top grade is renamed PASSED, a rarity screen, necessary and never sufficient for WHAT_WOULD_COUNT's DERIVED, never a physical admission. No grade on the record changes: B1518's T2 YES and T3 NO and its FITTED (0.9857 -> 0.9871) stand, and no positive was ever graded DERIVED. E31 instance, caught by the audit lane. 0 of 19.
